title: GhostCrabWorkspaceModelExport
description: Machine-readable semantic model of a GhostCrab workspace, produced by ghostcrab_workspace_export_model. Consumed by synthetic data generators and validation agents.

schema_version.description: SemVer of this export contract. Breaking changes bump the major version.

exported_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this model was exported.

tables.description: Semantic descriptors for all Layer 1 tables in the workspace.

columns.description: Semantic descriptors for individual columns. Keyed by schema_name + table_name + column_name.

validation_warnings.description: List of semantic inconsistencies detected at export time (DDL tables missing annotations, orphaned column semantics, etc.).

domain_profile.description: Logical domain classification, e.g. casino, crm, kanban, project_delivery.

pg_schema.description: PostgreSQL schema name used for Layer 1 tables.

TableRole.description:
Business role of this table. Drives generation strategy selection.
- actor: a persistent entity that performs actions (players, contacts, users)
- event: an immutable record of something that happened (visits, clicks, logs)
- transaction: a financial or state-change record (payments, bookings)
- stateful_item: an entity that transitions through lifecycle states (tasks, orders, leads)
- reference: a small, stable lookup table (game types, categories, regions)
- hierarchy: a self-referencing or tree-structured table (org charts, nested categories)
- association: a many-to-many join table with its own attributes

GenerationStrategy.description:
How a synthetic generator should approach populating this table.
- seed_table: generate N independent root records
- per_parent: generate X records per parent row (respects FK hierarchy)
- time_series: distribute records across a time window with realistic density
- sparse_events: low-frequency events, not every parent has one
- static_ref: small static reference data, typically < 50 rows

VolumeDriver.description: Expected relative row count. Guides multipliers: tiny<50, low<500, medium<10k, high<1M+

entity_family.description: Semantic entity type, e.g. player, contact, task, opportunity.

primary_time_column.description: Column that represents the primary temporal dimension for this table.

emit_facets.description: Whether records from this table should be indexed in mfo_facets.

emit_graph_entities.description: Whether records from this table should produce graph.entity nodes.

emit_graph_relations.description: Whether records from this table should produce graph.relation edges.

emit_projections.description: Whether this table contributes signals to mfo_projections.

notes.description: Freeform JSONB metadata for this table.

ColumnRole.description:
Semantic role of this column. Drives value generation strategy.
- id: primary key or unique identifier
- fk: foreign key reference to another table
- status: lifecycle state enum (active, closed, pending)
- timestamp: temporal column
- amount: numeric monetary or quantity value
- score: numeric ranking or probability
- category: discrete classification
- owner: user/actor reference
- parent_ref: self-referential FK for hierarchy
- text_content: free text, description, note
- geo: geographic coordinates or region code
- embedding_source: source text for vector embedding
- label: human-readable name or title
- flag: boolean indicator

SemanticType.description: Abstract semantic type independent of SQL storage type.

GraphUsage.description: How this column is used when building the graph layer.

facet_key.description: If set, this column maps to this facet key in mfo_facets.

projection_signal.description: Signal name used in mfo_projections, e.g. alert_trigger, priority, rank_signal.

is_nullable.description: Whether this column allows NULL values.

distribution_hint.description: Hints for synthetic value generation (enum values, range, format).

hierarchical.description: True if this relation defines a parent-child hierarchy.

graph_label.description: Edge label in the graph layer, e.g. CONTAINS, BLOCKS, TARGETED_BY.

GenerationHints.description: Aggregate hints for a synthetic generator about how to approach this workspace.

table_order.description: Topologically sorted list of fully-qualified table names (schema.table) for insertion order. Parents before children.

estimated_total_rows.description: Rough estimate of total rows across all Layer 1 tables after generation.

seed_multipliers.description: Suggested row counts per volume_driver tier.

domain_profile.description: Domain profile identifier for domain-specific generation recipes.

time_window_days.description: Number of days in the past to spread time_series events across.
